qiongli_project_document_read.name: qiongli_project_document_read
qiongli_project_document_read.description: Read or search one explicitly selected saved paper note, source packet, retrieval_manifest.csv or context/stage_summaries/STG-*.md summary. Requires the expected project revision and whole-file SHA-256 from authorized binding evidence. Without search_text, read a bounded UTF-8 window; optional json_pointer selects an observed saved packet string and offsets address decoded text. With search_text, find literal, case-sensitive, non-overlapping matches within each decoded packet string value (including metadata), one selected string, or raw note/manifest/summary text. No normalization, cross-field match or full-paper coverage is implied. Search returns bounded contexts and exact readArguments; context_bytes defaults to 128 and accepts 4..512 bytes per side. For longer passages, use returned readArguments in read mode. Continuation retains query/scope/page settings plus searchSha256. Read controls offset_bytes/max_bytes and search controls are mutually exclusive. Recheck source identity on every call. This local snapshot is not source-support verification, Graph authority or write permission. This tool is part of plugin `Qiongli`.

relative_path.description: Only notes/<citekey>.md, sources/<citekey>/<sha256>.json, retrieval_manifest.csv, or context/stage_summaries/STG-*.md; never an absolute path.

json_pointer.description: Optional JSON Pointer into sources/<citekey>/<sha256>.json, selecting a string. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1 within keys. Missing/non-string targets, duplicate JSON keys, control characters and invalid escapes refuse. Observe the pointer from actual packet structure; never guess an original paper page from byte offsets.

search_text.description: Select search mode. Exact non-whitespace-only query of 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; no NUL. Literal case-sensitive matches do not overlap or span packet string values.

match_offset.description: Search mode only. Zero-based match cursor in deterministic pointer order; values above zero require expected_search_sha256.

max_matches.description: Search mode only. Maximum matches returned per page.

context_bytes.description: Search mode only. Up to this many UTF-8 bytes on each side of each match, rounded inward to character boundaries.

expected_search_sha256.description: Search mode only. Required for match_offset > 0; use searchSha256 from the preceding page. Binds source identity, revision, query, pointer, context and page size.

qiongli_project_read.name: qiongli_project_read
qiongli_project_read.description: Read one registered article-project summary by stable project identity without returning its filesystem path. This tool is part of plugin `Qiongli`.

qiongli_project_document_list.name: qiongli_project_document_list
qiongli_project_document_list.description: List saved paper-note, source-packet, retrieval-manifest and stage-summary bindings from validated consolidation receipts in one registered project. Read the current project revision first. Omit limit for the default page size of 32; an explicit limit must be 1–64. Only current entries supply readArguments for qiongli_project_document_read; missing, changed or unavailable files require review, never a substituted hash. Pages are sorted by relative path; continuation requires the same revision and bindingsSha256. This is bounded local history, not remote verification, a file scan or write permission. This tool is part of plugin `Qiongli`.

expected_bindings_sha256.description: Required for offset > 0. Use bindingsSha256 from the preceding list page; binds the complete saved receipt/capture set, not current file bytes.
